US Blacklists Alibaba-Linked Firms Over Chip Diversion to China

The United States has blacklisted six entities, including Alibaba-linked Apex Enterprise Solutions and Megaspeed International, along with five other companies, due to concerns about the potential diversion of advanced AI chips to China. Alibaba has contested the U.S. action, while Singapore has stated its investigation into Megaspeed is continuing.
